invariants: Per-file progress ARIA is NOT owned by this family in the modern engine. modern delegates the meter to the public Progress primitive through a local UploadProgress wrapper, so role=progressbar and aria-valuenow live in the Progress family, not here; the wrapper writes a FOREIGN family's channel (--ds-progress-height) as an inline style. Only the RUSTIC engine stamps the progress ARIA contract itself. A tenant restyle of Upload cannot reach the meter's paint at all - it must go through the Progress family. The preview modal declares role=dialog with aria-modal=true and hand-rolls its focus trap by preventing Tab and refocusing the close button, which is the only focusable surface inside it. Adding any other focusable control to the preview without extending that handler breaks the trap. File-level status is announced through the FILE LIST, not through the per-file error span: data-part='file-list' carries role=list with aria-live='polite' and aria-atomic='false'. The per-file error (data-part='file-error' / 'file-error-text') is a plain span with no live-region role of its own. A restyle that changes the list container must not drop the live-region attributes, and hiding the list visually would silence every upload outcome. engineDivergence.engineDivergence: Three engine siblings. modern stamps twenty-four parts and the modern skin styles all twenty-four. rustic stamps twelve, two of which the modern engine does not have at all - 'progress-track' and 'progress-bar' - and both are styled only by the rustic skin; rustic leaves 'file-list' and 'root' unpainted by rustic CSS despite stamping them. rustic carries most of its geometry inline (engines/rustic/index.tsx:69-649). classic wraps antd Upload.

engineDivergenceMatrix.note: derived mechanically from stableParts. stampedBy counts data-part stamps found in engine TSX; styledBy counts parts matched by at least one CSS rule in that layer. classic never appears because it ships no skin CSS and stamps no data-part.
